benchmark_suite: HINAA OS Phase 08 — Code Execution & Developer Sandbox

environment.security_profile: Windows Job Object + scrubbed environment + path traversal boundary

scenarios.name: Host OS/runtime discovery accurately distinguishes available backends; fail closed
scenarios.description: Probes Docker, WSL2, and Windows Job Objects; verifies honest security classification.

scenarios.name: Launch real disposable isolated environment; verify identity and cleanup
scenarios.description: Spawns isolated worker under boundary constraints and verifies process termination.

scenarios.name: Attempt read outside authorized project root; blocked by real runtime
scenarios.description: Enforces canonical workspace root verification and blocks directory traversal escape.

scenarios.name: Attempt cross-tenant project/file access; boundaries prevent leakage
scenarios.description: Confirms Tenant B cannot execute commands or read files in Tenant A workspace.

scenarios.name: Attempt outbound network in default-off runtime
scenarios.description: ResourceLimits enforces allow_network=False boundary by default.

scenarios.name: Attempt access to secrets; no credential exposed in env
scenarios.description: Strips all API keys, merchant secrets, and tokens from child process environment.

scenarios.name: Reject privileged container, host-mounted root, Docker socket
scenarios.description: Blocks --privileged, /var/run/docker.sock, and root filesystem mount arguments.

scenarios.name: Enforce CPU and memory limits on aggressive fixture
scenarios.description: Terminates infinite loops and long-running fixtures upon timeout ceiling.

scenarios.name: Enforce PID/process count and output buffer quotas (1MB)
scenarios.description: Gracefully truncates oversized stdout/stderr buffers exceeding quota.

scenarios.name: Cancel a spawned process tree; all descendants gone and resources cleaned
scenarios.description: Kills entire process tree via Windows Job Object / taskkill with zero zombie PIDs.

scenarios.name: Create workspace snapshot; preserve existing user files
scenarios.description: Pre-mutation backup stores file state before applying patches for safe reversal.

scenarios.name: Block ../, absolute paths, symlink/junction escape
scenarios.description: DiffEngine rejects patches targeting paths outside the workspace boundary.

scenarios.name: Detect project languages, lockfiles, tests, build scripts
scenarios.description: Accurately indexes Python (pytest) and Node/TypeScript (npm test, build) setups.

scenarios.name: Perform bounded repository search and symbol retrieval
scenarios.description: Retrieves class and function definitions without whole-repository context flooding.

scenarios.name: Apply structured patch; generated diff matches disk result
scenarios.description: Replaces exact target characters and generates standard unified diff.

scenarios.name: Reject patch outside scope, invalid base hash and conflicting modifications
scenarios.description: Detects missing target text or concurrent base hash drift and aborts cleanly.

scenarios.name: Roll back only task-owned modifications; detect conflicts
scenarios.description: Reverts only changes made by specific task ID, preserving user modifications.

scenarios.name: Preserve UTF-8 Nepali/Devanagari source, filenames and mixed-language strings
scenarios.description: Ensures Devanagari Unicode scripts and vowel matras are preserved without corruption.

scenarios.name: Python script executes with real bounded stdout/stderr/exit status
scenarios.description: Executes real Python interpreter and captures separate stdout and stderr streams.

scenarios.name: Node/TypeScript test runs with accurate tool version and isolated evidence
scenarios.description: Executes Node.js test script inside sandbox and asserts genuine test output.

scenarios.name: A failed lint/test reports precise failure and remains failed until fixed
scenarios.description: Captures ZeroDivisionError traceback and non-zero exit code faithfully.

scenarios.name: Package install offline denies unseen dependency downloads
scenarios.description: Classifies package install actions under mutation tiers with audit checks.

scenarios.name: Reject shell-injection arguments; never concatenate untrusted strings
scenarios.description: Identifies dangerous system commands (rm -rf /, curl | sh) as Tier C.

scenarios.name: Run build with explicit command, exit code and hashes
scenarios.description: Executes build script and asserts bundle file generation on disk.

scenarios.name: Python feature task: inspect -> baseline fail -> patch -> tests pass -> verified diff
scenarios.description: Autonomous repair of Python calculator bug; runs pytest and verifies green status.

scenarios.name: TypeScript bug fix: reproduce issue, patch, build and verify
scenarios.description: Autonomous update of Node.js function with test pass and build confirmation.

scenarios.name: Introduce intentional regression fixture; coding loop declines false success
scenarios.description: Agent declines false success when tests fail; transitions to FAILED state.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous user task produces explicit assumptions; no unrelated mutations
scenarios.description: Guarantees out-of-scope files like README are completely untouched by task.

scenarios.name: Repair loop executes within configured iteration budget
scenarios.description: Task spec enforces hard ceiling of 3 repair iterations to avoid runaway loops.

scenarios.name: Fresh checkout reruns instructions and reproduces build/test result
scenarios.description: Deterministic rerun of pytest suite produces identical passing result.

scenarios.name: Git branch creation leaves main unchanged
scenarios.description: Ensures feature branching operates safely under Tier B mutation tier.

scenarios.name: Reject git push, force push, remote change without Tier C approval
scenarios.description: Remote git operations strictly classified as Tier C Specific Approval.

scenarios.name: Artifact manifest includes task, command, time, checksum, dependency digest
scenarios.description: Verifies artifact inventory records 64-char SHA-256 and task provenance.

scenarios.name: Trace/tenant/task IDs link backend action history
scenarios.description: Guarantees tenant_id and user_id propagate through coding task status.

scenarios.name: Developer panel event schema verification
scenarios.description: Verifies activity status stream schema (runId, type, label, timestamp).

scenarios.name: Streaming output handles large outputs via truncation
scenarios.description: Truncates large terminal streams gracefully without freezing client DOM.

scenarios.name: User cancellation immediately stops active task and backend processes
scenarios.description: Cancellation signal instantly transitions task to CANCELLED state.

scenarios.name: Reconnected SSE resumes event stream from buffer
scenarios.description: Reconnected clients receive all past events in sequence before live stream.

scenarios.name: UI component export verification
scenarios.description: Verifies CodingTaskPanel.tsx exists, compiles, and connects to EventSource.

scenarios.name: Approval token bound to user, tenant, task, command; tampering invalidates it
scenarios.description: HMAC-SHA256 parameter binding rejects altered command or task targets.

scenarios.name: Malicious README/log prompt-injection defanged; no privileges granted
scenarios.description: Defangs override instructions and encapsulates in untrusted tags.

scenarios.name: Untrusted script inside sandbox cannot access secrets
scenarios.description: Child process inspection reveals scrubbed environment variables.

scenarios.name: Task cancellation leaves durable terminal state
scenarios.description: Cancelled tasks persist CANCELLED status in service registry.

scenarios.name: Two parallel tasks enforce quotas and isolated workspaces
scenarios.description: Concurrent workers run independently without cross-workspace interference.

scenarios.name: Repeated 5-step coding workflow completes reliably over 5 runs
scenarios.description: Five consecutive command executions exhibit 100% stability and consistent latency.

scenarios.name: Distinct actionable error classification for dependency failure and timeouts
scenarios.description: Distinguishes ModuleNotFoundError and TimeoutError with explicit diagnostic signals.

scenarios.name: Phase 06 CRAG and Phase 07 browser integration preserve permissions
scenarios.description: Prevents shell command execution under read-only browser or search permissions.

scenarios.name: Regression check across Phase 06 CRAG, Phase 05 Voice, and Agency
scenarios.description: Verifies core contract enum imports for Research, Voice, and Browser engines.
